briefdescription.para: A simple and fast domtree-based CSE pass.

detaileddescription.para: This pass does a simple depth-first walk over the dominator tree, eliminating trivially redundant instructions and using instsimplify to canonicalize things as it goes. It is intended to be fast and catch obvious cases so that instcombine and other passes are more effective. It is expected that a later pass of GVN will catch the interesting/hard cases.
